map.用地分类代码 R/A/B/M/S/U/G 分别代表什么？: What do the land use codes R/A/B/M/S/U/G stand for?
map.R 居住用地、A 公共管理与公共服务、B 商业服务业设施、M 工业、S 道路与交: R residential land, A public administration and public services, B commercial and service facilities, M industrial, S road and traffic facilities, U utilities, G green space and squares. These are the level-1 category codes of "Standard for Classification of Urban Land Use and Planning Construction Land" GB 50137.
map.人均建设用地标准的意义？: What is the significance of the per-capita construction land standard?
map.它反映了规划的人均土地集约程度，是控规的核心指标之一。标准按城市规模（大/中/小: It reflects the planned per-capita land intensity and is one of the core regulatory indicators. The standard gives ranges by city size (metropolis / medium city / small city / town / village); too low means crowding, too high means wasted land.

map.请填写大于 0 的规划人口；缺少人口时不作达标判断。: Enter a planned population greater than 0; no compliance judgement is made without population.
map.面积可填 0，但不能留空或为负数。: Areas may be 0 but must not be blank or negative.
map.总用地为 0，无法计算各类用地比例或人均指标；请至少填写一类大于 0 的用地面积: Total land is 0, so land-use shares and per-capita indicators cannot be calculated; enter at least one land-use area greater than 0.
map.面积留空、负数或非数值会被拒绝，显式填 0 合法；总用地为 0 时不显示 100: Blank, negative or non-numeric areas are rejected; an explicit 0 is valid. When total land is 0, no 100% share or compliance conclusion is shown; when population is missing, old results are cleared and “incomplete check” is shown.
map.面积留空或填 0 怎么处理？: What happens if an area is blank or 0?
map.七类用地面积必须逐项填写，显式填 0 合法且参与求和；留空、负数或非数值会被拒绝: All seven land-use areas must be filled; an explicit 0 is valid and included in the sum. Blank, negative or non-numeric values are rejected and old results are cleared. When the total is 0, shares cannot be calculated, so 100% is not shown and no compliance conclusion is output.
